sloka: बलं मम न खल्वेतन्मर्यादैषा निसर्गतः ।स दृष्टो न मया कालं मुहुर्तमापि जीवति ।। ७.२२.३१ ॥
transliteration: balaṁ mama na khalvetanmaryādaiṣā nisargataḥ ।sa dṛṣṭo na mayā kālaṁ muhurtamāpi jīvati ।। 7.22.31 ॥

translations.english: O knower of dharma, release me so I may kill this one, for no one seen by me, however powerful, has ever lived.
